- `Abilene.graphml` and `Geant2012.graphml`: Internet Topology Zoo (github.com/mroughan/InternetTopologyZoo),
  CC BY 4.0. Copied unchanged from telecom-kg as test backbones (Abilene: 11 PoPs, 14 links; GÉANT 2012: 40 PoPs).
- `ontology-build/`: the subset of samyama-ontologies' telecom vocabulary builds that the
  telecom pack binds to (label concepts and the three enumerations), so tests run without a
  samyama-ontologies checkout. NORIA-O content is BSD-4-Clause, (c) Orange: "This product
  includes software developed by Orange." RFC 8632/8345 content: Simplified BSD (IETF Trust).
  TMF642 content: Apache-2.0 (TM Forum).
